known_data: Existing published value and policy readouts were already inspected; this is not blinded validation or a pre-inference registration.
value_formula: (1-alpha)*normalized stored SF WDL +alpha*normalized BT4 native probability WDL; float16 storage then normalization for descriptive consumption metrics.

reverse_policy.reference: B100 policy from normalized legal BT4 probabilities exponent1/T, original SF search value unchanged.
reverse_policy.candidate_definition: Top3 legal moves by B100 T.5 probability, intersect probability>=ratio*pmax. Stable compact-index tiebreak for exact BT4 ties. All sets include the BT4 best.
reverse_policy.SF_rerank: Maximum original float64 raw d9 effective_cp within the set; ties prefer higher BT4 probability then compact index. No target array constructed or temperature fitted.
metrics: SF rerank differs from BT4 top
SF cp improvement on nonmate rows only

weights: Reuse each qualified sample inverse-inclusion weights, normalized per group; no iid intervals/population-optimality claims.
preserve: Frozen B100V10 plan untouched; this readout suggests prospective dose/recipe questions only. No engine/model/corpus reads or inference; existing saved bank parts only.
